train_imagenet_model: train an image classification model on ImageNet using MXNet Gluon with configurable batch size and epochs
parse_training_args: parse command line arguments for model training including learning rate, batch size, and GPU count
configure_data_loader: configure data loading from ImageNet using either record files or raw images with augmentation transforms
apply_mixup_training: apply mixup data augmentation technique with configurable beta distribution parameter during training
evaluate_model_accuracy: evaluate trained model accuracy on validation set using top-1 and top-5 accuracy metrics
